text.jp: 怒りをぶつけるように
哀しみに肩を落として
今にも泣き出しそうに
text.real_en: As if about to burst into tears.

text.jp: 苦悩をにじませながら

text.real_en: With a face clouded by anguish.

text.jp: あたたかな愛をこめて
憎しみに身を震わせて

世間を騒がす正体不明の大泥棒マスカリーナ。

大胆にも、神殿の大祭司のもとへ
『次は聖典を盗み出す』という
予告状が届く。

その話を聞いた信心深い賢者は一計を案じ
衛兵達を鎧の置物の中で待ち伏せさせ、
大泥棒を捕まえんとする。

泥棒と賢者の知恵比べ捕り物帳！
text.official_en:
Notorious in name and deed, the daring thief Mascarina
seems to always be a step ahead!

But when she delivers a warning to the high priest,
saying, "Next, I steal your holy book," a sage in the
temple devises a plan for the guards to conceal
themselves in decorative armor and ambush her.

Who will win in this battle of wits between a sage and an
intrepid thief?

text.jp: 大泥棒マスカリーナ登場！
賢者、知恵比べに勝利す

放蕩の果てに大借金を作り妻子と別れた道楽者。
無一文で流離っていたところ、飢えた老人に出会い
持っていた最後の麺麭を与えると、
礼に古い地図を手渡される。

なんとそれは「魔道士アウレウス」が残した
黄金の在処を示すものだという。

黄金の噂を聞いた妻子と共に
人生の逆転をかけた、黄金探しがはじまる！
text.official_en:
A rake's debauched lifestyle lands them deep in debt and
separated from their family. Penniless and living in exile,
they run into a starving old derelict and give them a scrap
of bread, receiving in return an old map.

Lo and behold, the map shows the location of the gold left
behind by the mage Aureus.

With their family member who'd heard rumors of
the gold, the rake departs in search of treasure—and a
way to turn their life around.
The rake's family member, played by <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp: 帝都じゃじゃ馬騒動記
text.real_en: The Unruly Girl Incident in the Imperial Capital

text.jp:
帝都へとやってきた破天荒な主人公
通称「じゃじゃ馬」。
その目的は、きょうだいを探すこと。

船の事故で死んだと思っていたが
姿を見た者がいるという噂を聞いたのだ。

しかし、きょうだいを探す中、
性格が災いしてあちこちで騒動を起こしてしまい……

果たしてきょうだいは生きているのか？
そして、じゃじゃ馬は再会できるのか？
帝都を舞台に繰り広げられる人情喜劇！
text.official_en:
An unconventional protagonist comes to the imperial
capital—they're known as the shrew, and they're looking
for someone.

After long believing that their sibling had been lost at sea,
they recently heard rumors of a reappearance.

But the shrew's personality ends up getting in the way of
the search, and they start causing trouble left and right.

Could their sibling be alive? Will the shrew find them?
A comedy of errors set in the imperial capital!

text.jp:
とある名家の跡取りである主人公は
狩りの途中で迷い込んだ森の奥に暮らす
隠者の子と恋に落ちる。

逢瀬を重ねて愛を深める二人であったが
名家にかつて騙された過去を持つ隠者は
婚約の指輪と偽って密かに名家の跡取りに
呪いの指輪をもたせ、呪い殺そうとたくらむのだった。

隠者の子は指輪を取り返そうとするが
それを心変わりだと誤解した跡取りは
失意の為に湖に身を投げてしまい……

恋人たちを襲う哀しい運命の物語。
text.official_en:
The protagonist, the scion of a noble house, wanders
into the woods on a hunting trip and falls in love
with the child of a hermit.

The couple deepens their love through many trysts.
The hermit, who had once been cheated by the noble's
house, secretly gives the noble a cursed ring disguised as
a betrothal ring in order to kill them.

The hermit's child attempts to take the ring back,
but the noble, mistaking this for a change of heart,
throws themself into the lake in despair...

A tale of the sad fate that befalls two lovers.

text.jp:
長い争いと混乱の時代を経て
仮初めの平和を得たものの、
戦争まで一触即発の状態にある西国と東国。

その国境の関所に詰める両国の兵士。
二人は同じ村にすむ幼なじみであったが、
戦争によって新たな国境がひかれ
相争う間柄となってしまったのだった。

国境越しに言葉をかわし、仲良く笑い合う二人。
しかしついに戦争はおこり、二人は戦うことに……

戦下に花咲いた、儚き友情への哀歌。
text.official_en:
After a long period of turmoil and strife, the East and
the West had found temporary peace. Now, however,
they are on the brink of war again.

Soldiers from both sides are stationed at the border
checkpoint. Two of them are childhood friends who come
from the same village, but the conflict has drawn a new
border and now they must face as enemies.

They exchange words and laughter across the border.
But then the violence begins, and they must fight...

A lament for a long-lost friendship that rekindles
during wartime.

text.jp:
戦争で当主を失い、没落したとある国の名門貴族。
その嫡子は復讐を果たすため、使用人と偽って
親を殺した将軍の家に潜入する。

しかし、あろうことか、貴族の嫡子は
その将軍と恋におちてしまうのだった。

そこへ舞い込む、祖国への更なる侵攻計画の報せ。
貴族の嫡子は自分の正体を明かし、国に帰るという。

嫡子を愛してしまった将軍は
国を捨て、二人で逃げようと誘うが……？

運命に翻弄される二人の、愛の悲劇。
text.official_en:
When the nation's head of state is lost in battle, a noble
falls into ruin. Their heir, planning to exact revenge,
pretends to be a servant and infiltrates the house of the
general who killed their parent.

However, despite their intentions, the heir falls in love
with the general!

Then comes news of a plan to invade their country once
again. The noble heir reveals their true identity and
makes plans to return to their home...but the general,
who has fallen in love with the heir, invites them to
abandon their country and run away together!

A tragic love story of a couple at the mercy of fate.

text.real_en: The Fall of a Noble House

text.official_en:
After running away with the noble's heir, the general,
played by <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>

text.jp:
とある神を信奉し、祈りを絶やさぬ羊飼いがいた。
神はその羊飼いの信仰心を試そうと試練を与える。

育てた作物を失い
家畜を失い
蓄えを失い
病となり……

しかし、羊飼いは神の名を呼び、
どんな苦難にも信仰を失うことはなかった。

そんな羊飼いを待っていたものとは……？
人と神との、苦しくも美しき物語。
text.official_en:
There was once a shepherd who worshipped a god,
lavishing them every day with prayers. But the god gave 
the shepherd trials to test their faith.

They lost their crops, their livestock, their savings.
They fell ill...

Still the shepherd called out the god's name and did not
lose faith, no matter the hardship.

What awaited the shepherd then? A painful yet beautiful
story of humans and gods.

text.jp:
日々戦いにあけくれる剣闘士たち。
噂では、闘技場には望まぬ死を迎えた剣闘士の亡霊が
幻影となって現れるという。

主人公である若き剣闘士は、その幻影と出会い
彼から黒い剣を受け取り、勝利を重ね
名声を高めていく。

だが、剣闘士は人気に増長し、傲慢になっていく。
優勝を決める一戦。相手にトドメを刺そうとした時に
黒い剣はくだけてしまい……

栄光と挫折の影に蠢く、血塗られた怪奇の物語！
text.official_en:
Gladiators are no strangers to the specter of death.
But when one gladiator was cut down, they returned to
the arena as a literal ghost—known as the phantom.

The protagonist, a young gladiator, meets this phantom
and receives a black sword, and their fame grows with
each victory.

However, as the gladiator's popularity grows, they
become arrogant—until, during the final battle to
determine the winner, the black sword breaks...

A bloody, bizarre tale that lurks in the shadows of glory
and failure!

text.jp: イアペトスにかかる虹

ダグザの北に連なるイアペトス山脈。
そこには偉大なる精霊たちが住み、
山に虹がかかる時、人前に姿を現すといわれる。

偶然虹の出る日に山に登った主人公の木こりは
精霊に導かれ、精霊の王のもとを訪れる。

なんという幸運！　と思ったのもつかの間
そこで山を荒らす罪人として裁かれそうになり……

虹が消えるまでの間に、神秘の山で起こった
人間と精霊たちとの美しい幻想譚。
text.official_en:
The Iapetus Mountains are a sacred mountain range
in northern Dagda. Numerous spirits reside there and
are said to appear before humans during rainbows.

A woodcutter climbs the mountains during a rainbow,
and the spirits guide them to the spirit sovereign.

Just as they consider their fortune, they learn they
are to be tried as a criminal who destroyed the area.

A fantasy of humans and spirits, shining with all the
colors of the rainbow.

text.jp: 戯曲・闘技場の白髪鬼

ダグザ文学史における大傑作と名高い
あの「闘技場の白髪鬼」がついに舞台化！

親友に大罪人に仕立てられた若き将軍は
処刑の寸前、軍神マーズに助けられ
闘技場の試煉に挑むこととなり
「白髪鬼」と呼ばれるようになる。

並み居る強敵たちとの戦い、
仕組まれた敵対者の罠、
美しい神官との恋と別離……

白髪鬼は今日も苦難に立ち向かい続ける
いつか潔白を証明し、自由を掴むその日まで……！
text.official_en:
The Rise of the White-Maned Demon, one of Dagda's
greatest literary masterpieces, finally comes to the stage!

A young general, framed by his best friend, is on the
verge of being executed when he is saved by Mars,
the Bringer of War. He must undertake a trial in the
arena and becomes known as the White-Maned Demon.

Battles with powerful foes, traps set by his enemies,
love and separation from a beautiful priest...

Even now, the White-Maned Demon continues to face
hardships, until the day comes when he can finally
prove his innocence and seize his freedom.

text.jp:
大帝ダグザと人の間にうまれた英雄アラゴ。
彼はダグザの各地で勇名を馳せ、
そして多くの浮名を流した。
そんなアラゴが成した、武勇伝の数々が
舞台の上で熱演さる！

「巨大サンドバアル退治」
「リュディア族の王と一騎打ち」
「美女オリヴィアとの峠越え」
「ブリギット王との誓いの戦い」
などなど……

あなたは今、歴史の目撃者となる。
text.official_en:
The hero Arago, a human born to Divine Emperor Dagda,
was renowned throughout Dagda, not only for his valor
but also for his many romantic entanglements. Now, the
saga of Arago's heroic deeds will be passionately
performed on stage!

From his extermination of the giant sandbael, to his duel
with the chief of the Lydians, to his crossing of the
mountain pass with the beautiful Olivia, to his battle to 
uphold his vow to the king of Brigid—it is all retold here!

Prepare to witness history.

text.jp: 稀代の歌い手コーエン

その名を知らぬ者なき、歌と演奏の天才にして、
稀代の吟遊詩人であるコーエンの物語！

コーエンは多くの曲を作り、奏でることを願い
ビウエラを手に、ダグザ中を旅し、
そこで数々の伝説を残した。
曰く『大発生したネズミを、歌で追い払った』
曰く『樽の水を、演奏で芳醇なゴーシュに変えた』
曰く『巨大な山を、ビウエラの調べで動かした』

人々を魅了した、輝ける若き日から、
芸術の神カーラに弔われる、その落日まで、
感動の生涯を綴る、一大絵巻！
text.official_en:
The story of peerless bard Cohen—a prodigy whose name
is known by all!

Cohen traveled all over Dagda with vihuela in hand,
composing and performing songs of all kinds, leaving
legend after legend in his wake. It is said that with his
music, he drove away a rat infestation and turned a
barrel of water into mellow ghosh. Indeed, legend has it
that the man's playing once moved a mountain!

This illustrative performance recounts his moving
life story, from his promising youth to his tragic downfall.
